timebase: seconds in prepared 1.05x, pitch-preserved playback; zero at first decoded sample

method.name: Spotify Basic Pitch ICASSP2022 ONNX + official polyphonic note decoder
method.licence: Apache-2.0; model and upstream code are analysis dependencies, not shipped runtime code
method.runtime: onnxruntime CPUExecutionProvider; 2 intra-operation threads, 1 inter-operation thread; no GPU
method.confidence: 0.65 * mean note-frame activation + 0.35 * nearby model onset activation; not a calibrated probability
method.velocity: mean model note activation, the official decoder amplitude; not a calibrated MIDI loudness
method.energyDbFS: actual 80 ms mono PCM RMS at detected onset; shared polyphonic energy, not an isolated note amplitude
method.timing: official Basic Pitch model_frames_to_time correction; coordinates are prepared-audio seconds, no tempo quantization or score snapping
limitations: Unvalidated automatic transcription: omissions, octave errors, split or merged repeated notes and overtone detections remain possible.
Marimba resonance and room reflections can blur duration; inferred offsets describe detected energy rather than mallet contact or score duration.
No manual correction, musician review or score alignment has been performed. Each event is a candidate, not certified every-note truth.
